title: pm-dispatch(sign-off): a seat going off shift hands every unlanded claimed card back to pm:queue, instead of keeping it as stay-behind
body:
domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

Filing gate **③**: a maintainer-directed change to a pm rule. The maintainer (Sales) named it in the Sales account's Objectstack project, thread "server 席 1", at 2026-10-29T02:32Z. Verbatim, not translated: 「下班时卡片应该交回队列，这个应该立卡更新 skills」. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and the grade.

## What happened (the measurement)

- `domain:server` seat 1 (#6367) was held by `os-project-manager`, session `session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC`. That project's maintainer ended the shift on 2026-10-28 (comment 6466738832 on #25467 quotes 「当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」).
- The seat released one card, #25467 cut 32 (`Release:` 6468281430), under its maintainer's 「已认领、还没开工的应该放回队列」.
- It left two cards assigned and `pm:dispatched` with nothing running:
  - #25805: the dev reported `needs_decision` on 2026-10-26 (6411403302). The card was never moved to `needs-user-decision`, so the question reached no maintainer.
  - #23181: a `Part of` series. Slices up to 17 landed by 2026-10-27T06:34Z, and no slice is in flight.
- #6367 has no sign-off brief, and its title still reads 🟢. On 2026-10-29 the next seat could take these two cards only by forced takeover.

## Governing text today

- `references/seat-post-protocol.md` 〈活性、写侧刷新与收班〉: 「安置默认离任留守;留不了才热移交」. Stay-behind is the default disposition at shift end.
- `references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉: 「收班 = 状态 flush + 在飞显式安置,不是在飞归零」.
- `references/seat-post-protocol.md` 〈交接收尾清单〉 step 2 already says each claimed card lands or is released (`Release:` plus a cleared assignee in one stroke), and `check-handover.mjs` checks it. But the checklist is worded for 交接 (handover), and the stay-behind default reads as an alternative to releasing.

## The change asked

1. At 下班 / 收班, every claimed card the seat holds goes back to `pm:queue` in one stroke, unless it is an ACCEPTed PR already waiting on the merge queue or on a human approval. The stroke is a `Release:` comment (with `Resume-from: BRANCH@SHA` when pushed work exists), the assignee cleared, and `pm:dispatched` replaced by `pm:queue`.
2. A card whose dev reported `needs_decision` goes to `needs-user-decision` with its analysis instead. It is never left `pm:dispatched`.
3. Stay-behind narrows to the ACCEPTed PRs of item 1.
4. The sign-off brief and the `check-handover.mjs` run are the shift's last acts, whatever the maintainer's wording for ending it.

## Business reason

The maintainer's words above. A card held by a seat that has gone home blocks every other seat and account from picking it up. The only way to free it is a forced takeover, which costs a maintainer decision and four comments per card.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:skills` seat: the rule text lives in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` and `seat-lifecycle.md`, and possibly in `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs`.

## Dedupe

- Query: issues in any state labelled `domain:skills` whose title matches `sign-off|off shift|stay-behind|收班|下班|handover|release`. 3 hits: #27017, #26368 and #25490. None is about this.
- Open `tooling` cards whose title matches `shift|stay|收班|下班|release|claim`: 0 hits.
